locations.name: Radio City Music Hall
locations.factShort: Radio City Music Hall (also known as Radio City) is an entertainment venue and theater at 1260 Avenue of the Americas, within Rockefeller Center, in the Midtown Manhattan neighborhood of New York City. Nicknamed "The Showplace of the Nation", it is the headquarters for the Rockettes.

locations.name: The Brooklyn Academy of Music
locations.factShort: The Brooklyn Academy of Music is a multi-arts center in Brooklyn, New York City. It hosts progressive and avant-garde performances, with theater, dance, music, opera, film programming across multiple nearby venues.

locations.name: The New York Hall of Science
locations.prompt: The New York Hall of Science
locations.factShort: The New York Hall of Science (branded as NYSCI) is a science museum at 47-01 111th Street, within Flushing Meadows–Corona Park, in the Corona neighborhood of Queens in New York City, New York, US.

locations.name: The Morris High School Historic District
locations.prompt: The Morris High School Historic District
locations.factShort: The Morris High School Historic District is a city and national historic district centered on Morris High School in Morrisania, Bronx, New York City. The district includes 51 contributing buildings on three city blocks.

locations.name: The Moravian Cemetery
locations.factShort: The Moravian Cemetery is a cemetery in the New Dorp neighborhood of Staten Island, New York, United States.
